topics.topic: PT Berlina Tbk (BRNA) PMHMETD III rights issue with Series I Warrants and DSU as standby buyer
topics.known_state: BRNA is issuing up to 543,950,000 new shares (nominal Rp50, exercise price Rp685, ratio 5 HMETD per 9 old shares) targeting up to Rp372,605,750,000 before issuance costs, with up to Rp264.38 billion of proceeds used to repay debt to 54.57% controlling shareholder DSU via a set-off mechanism. DSU will exercise all its HMETD, receive transferred HMETD from Lisjanto Tjiptobiantoro (27.65 million shares) and PT Niaga Karya Tunggal (18.42 million shares), and act as standby buyer for up to 43.07 million additional shares worth about Rp29.50 billion, potentially raising its stake to 67.41% and 70.22% after exercising Series I Warrants; non-exercising shareholders face dilution of up to 35.71%, or 42.55% if all warrants are exercised. BRNA will also issue up to 181,316,667 free Series I Warrants (one per three new shares, exercise price Rp800, exercisable 16 April 2027 to 15 October 2029) that could raise an additional Rp145.05 billion. Key dates: cum HMETD 8 October 2026, ex HMETD 9 October 2026, record date 12 October 2026, HMETD trading and exercise 14-21 October 2026, warrants tradable from 16 October 2026.

topics.topic: PT Wijaya Karya (Persero) Tbk (WIKA) financial restructuring program with phased asset divestments through 2028
topics.known_state: WIKA plans phased asset divestments between 2026 and 2028 under a financial restructuring program proposed to banks and bondholders, with the total reported as around Rp5.5 trillion in one article and Rp5 trillion in two others. For 2026 it targets around Rp1.9 trillion from four divestments (WTJJ, CMLJ, Wika Laswi, Tol Patimban); for 2027 three assets totaling approximately Rp276 billion (Dihydro, WR Hotel Khas, Witon, with Witon valued at Rp5 billion). WIKA targets completing restructuring of Rp27.8 trillion in liabilities in 2026, comprising Rp10.2 trillion in bonds and sukuk and Rp17.6 trillion in bank debt, with RUPO and RUPSU meetings to agree tenor, coupon, and interest terms. It also targets Rp13.6 trillion in non-CO sales with Rp1.25 trillion assumed gross profit and Rp25.7 trillion in new contracts in 2027 (up about 20% from the 2026 target). Its 33.36% stake in PSBI, part of Indonesia's roughly 60% ownership in KCIC, remains a key recovery factor, as WIKA bore Rp5.02 trillion in cost overruns and annual losses of Rp1.8 trillion from KCIC as of Q1 2026. WIKA's shares remain suspended and delisting risk has not been fully ruled out.

topics.topic: PT Cipta Selera Murni Tbk (CSMI) H1 2026 net loss
topics.known_state: CSMI, former Texas Chicken operator in Indonesia now running NWS Chicken with 4 outlets in Java and Sumatra, posted H1 2026 sales of Rp853.99 million (up from Rp815.83 million a year earlier), a net loss of Rp923.90 million, and accumulated losses of Rp69.48 billion as of June 30, 2026, attributed to high operational costs, materials/services adjustments, and expansion investments not yet offset by revenue. It ended cooperation with Cajun Global LLC on March 14, 2023 and plans to stabilize costs and gradually develop NWS Chicken.

topics.topic: PT Singaraja Putra Tbk (SINI) divests entire stake in PT Interkayu Nusantara for Rp31.8 billion
topics.known_state: SINI divested its entire stake in wood-processing subsidiary PT Interkayu Nusantara (IKN) for Rp31.8 billion; IKN will no longer be consolidated into SINI's financial statements, as part of strengthening its coal mining focus.

topics.topic: PT Singaraja Putra Tbk (SINI) Kalimantan coal portfolio expansion targeting around 2.2 million tons in 2026
topics.known_state: Through newly acquired subsidiary PT Kemilau Mulia Sakti (KMS), which holds a share participation in PT Cristian Eka Pratama (CEP), holder of an IUP-OP in West Kutai, East Kalimantan, SINI targets coal production of around 2.2 million tons in 2026, with KMS expected to contribute about Rp119 billion in revenue from July 1 to September 30, 2026. SINI expects PT Persada Kapuas Prima (PKP) and PT Pasir Bara Prima (PBP) to operate fully in 2026 per RKAB quotas, while PT Pesona Bara Cakrawala (PBC) targets first cut in 2027 and PT Cakrawala Bara Persada (CBP) in 2028; low river water levels are limiting barge transport and sales realization.

topics.topic: PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN) planned acquisition of new PT Singaraja Putra Tbk (SINI) shares under negotiation
topics.known_state: CUAN, which holds a direct and indirect 27.78% stake in SINI, is negotiating a new share acquisition plan; no definitive percentage, timeline, or signed shareholder agreement has been established yet.

topics.topic: PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI) completes divestment of Kestrel Coal stake to Yancoal Australia
topics.known_state: AADI, via subsidiary Adaro Capital Limited (ACL), completed the divestment of all shares and warrants in Kestrel Coal Group Pty Ltd to Yancoal Australia Limited on October 1, 2026 (Melbourne time), receiving approximately US$700 million after tax, equivalent to Rp12.6 trillion at Rp17,970 per US$ according to one article and Rp12.5 trillion according to another, with possible contingent cash consideration if required conditions are met. Proceeds will be used to develop the group's business in Indonesia, pay dividends, and strengthen the capital structure through partial repayment of group loans.

topics.topic: PT Perdana Gapuraprima Tbk (GPRA) Q2 2026 net profit more than triples to Rp24.2 billion
topics.known_state: GPRA reported semester I-2026 customer cash receipts up 5.6% to Rp154.5 billion, net sales of Rp202.8 billion, gross profit of Rp108.2 billion (53.4% gross margin), and net profit of Rp30.5 billion. In Q2-2026, net sales reached Rp121.9 billion, gross profit rose 37.1% to Rp63.8 billion, net profit more than tripled to Rp24.2 billion from Rp7.8 billion in Q2-2025, and customer cash receipts rose 9.8% to Rp91.9 billion. The company reduced bank debt by Rp25 billion in the first six months of 2026 and has paid cash dividends for three consecutive years.

topics.topic: Indonesia Stock Exchange reopens short selling with five initially eligible stocks
topics.known_state: IDX officially reopened short selling on Thursday, October 1, 2026, initially limited to ASII, BBCA, BRPT, BUMI, and INDF, available only through two bourse members, Semesta Indovest Sekuritas and Ajaib Sekuritas Asia. IDX President Director Jeffrey Hendrik said the first day ran smoothly with around 50 investors opening special accounts; on the first day the IHSG closed down 1.02%, or 61.63 points, at 6,009.50.

topics.topic: PT Garuda Indonesia Tbk (GIAA) planned rights issue of up to 124.35 billion Series E shares to fund GMFI share acquisition and working capital
topics.known_state: GIAA plans a PMHMETD III rights issue of up to 124,352,806,609 Series E shares with Rp25 nominal value, exercise price to be announced in the prospectus. Proceeds, net of issuance costs, will fund GIAA's acquisition of GMFI shares through PT Danantara Asset Management's non-cash inbreng and working capital for its 2026 stabilization and recovery plan, following the inbreng of PT Angkasa Pura Indonesia land into GMFI and transfer of API's GMFI shares to InJourney and then DAM. An Extraordinary GMS is scheduled for November 6, 2026 with results announced November 10, 2026, and an OJK effective statement is required within 12 months of approval; non-exercising shareholders face maximum dilution of about 23.4%. GIAA posted an H1 2026 net loss of US$120.72 million despite revenue rising around 16%, with consolidated equity improving to negative US$52.15 million and standalone equity to US$646.15 million as of June 30, 2026 after the GMFI share inbreng.

topics.topic: PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk (JPFA) and PT Ciomas Adisatwa divest 100% of PT Vaksindo Satwa Nusantara for Rp1.8 trillion
topics.known_state: JPFA and PT Ciomas Adisatwa divested their entire 100% stake (31,000 shares) in PT Vaksindo Satwa Nusantara for Rp1.8 trillion, equivalent to 8.47% of JPFA's consolidated equity as of June 2026, effective under a share purchase agreement signed September 29, 2026. Buyers are Japfa Pte. Ltd. (56.34% owner of JPFA) and Bionovas Pte. Ltd., keeping the transaction within the Japfa Group; the deal also transfers the Vaksindo, Vaksimune, and Vitakur trademarks from JPFA to Bionovas. JPFA cited improved capital allocation efficiency and reduced exposure to Vaksindo's higher-risk overseas expansion, with commercial and raw material supply arrangements continuing under substantially the same terms.

topics.topic: Indonesian government plans around Rp31 trillion in Q4-2026 economic stimulus
topics.known_state: The government plans around Rp31 trillion in Q4-2026 stimulus to support household consumption, including food aid of 10 kg of rice per month for three months for 33.24 million beneficiary families in deciles 1-4 with a budget of Rp17.5 trillion, wage subsidy assistance (BSU) of Rp300,000 per month for three months for about 13.3 million workers with a budget of nearly Rp12 trillion, plus a planned account-opening program for citizens above 17 years old in deciles 1-4.

topics.topic: PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk (DSSA) H1 2026 net profit up 79.59% to US$174.35 million
topics.known_state: DSSA posted January-June 2026 revenue of US$1.77 billion, up 33.98% YoY, with net profit of US$174.35 million, up 79.59% YoY. Coal mining and trading contributed US$1.53 billion (up 29.78% YoY), renewable energy revenue surged 153.91% YoY to US$176.97 million, cable TV and internet generated US$170.49 million (up 95.62% YoY), and digital solutions and data center lines added US$6.63 million and US$5.05 million respectively.

topics.topic: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (EMAS) and subsidiaries prepare up to Rp6.45 trillion unsecured loan facility for PT Pani Industri Nusantara
topics.known_state: EMAS and subsidiaries PT Gorontalo Sejahtera Mining (GSM) and PT Puncak Emas Tani Sejahtera (PETS) are preparing an unsecured loan facility of up to Rp6.45 trillion for PT Pani Industri Nusantara (PIN), which operates in precious metal refining and smelting, to support development of the Pani Gold Mine. EMAS provides up to Rp3.05 trillion and GSM and PETS each up to Rp1.70 trillion; the facility runs until the end of 2031, carries an interest rate of INDONIA plus 1.70%, and funds are usable for general corporate needs including capital and operational expenditure.

topics.topic: Tahir sells 45.17 million PT Maha Properti Indonesia Tbk (MPRO) shares in September 2026 for Rp548.62 billion
topics.known_state: Dato' Sri Tahir, a controlling shareholder of MPRO, sold 45.17 million shares across four transactions on September 18, 22, 24, and 28, 2026 at Rp12,000 per share, raising Rp548.62 billion and reducing his stake from 1,079 billion shares (10.86% of voting rights) to 1,034 billion shares (10.40%). He remains a controlling shareholder alongside his son Jonathan Tahir, who held 34.22% in early September 2026.

topics.topic: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk (BRIS) planned rights issue (PMHMETD II) of up to 6.8 billion Series B shares
topics.known_state: BRIS plans a rights issue of up to 6.8 billion Series B shares with Rp500 nominal value, projected to lift capital from Rp51.07 trillion in 2026 to Rp64.41 trillion in 2027 and CAR from 20.38% to 23.31%, with maximum dilution of 12.85% for non-exercising shareholders. BRIS is among listed banks with public shareholdings below the 15% free float requirement as of August 31, 2026 (9.33% free float).

topics.topic: Government Regulation No. 21 of 2026 on DHE SDA as loan collateral and first loan disbursements under the scheme
topics.known_state: Government Regulation No. 21 of 2026, effective September 2026, allows exporters to use natural resource export proceeds (DHE SDA) held at 15 designated banks as collateral for rupiah loans, with interest rates left to each bank's discretion. Under the scheme, Bank Rakyat Indonesia and Bank Mandiri have disbursed Rp6 trillion in loans to PT Bukit Asam Tbk (PTBA), comprising Rp2 trillion in working capital credit from BRI and Rp4 trillion in DHE SDA loans from Bank Mandiri for PTBA's operational needs.

topics.topic: OONA Indonesia divests 62 million ABDA shares for approximately Rp305.04 billion
topics.known_state: OONA Indonesia Pte Ltd, controlling shareholder of PT Asuransi Bina Dana Arta Tbk (ABDA), divested 62 million ABDA common shares on September 30, 2026 at Rp4,920 per share, raising approximately Rp305.04 billion. Its ownership fell from 538,604,204 shares (86.76% of voting rights) to 476,604,204 shares (76.77%), disclosed as a direct share divestment via an IDX information disclosure.

topics.topic: PT Era Media Sejahtera Tbk (DOOH) prepares four corporate actions including acquisition of 29.88% of PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk (INET) for approximately Rp2 trillion
topics.known_state: DOOH, under new controlling shareholder PT Sinergi Internasional Investama (SII), is preparing four interconnected corporate actions for its transformation into an integrated AI ecosystem infrastructure provider, to be approved at an EGM on November 9, 2026. The centerpiece is the acquisition by subsidiary PT Cakrawala Nexus Investama (CNI) of 29.88% of INET (approximately 6.68 billion shares at Rp300 per share), totaling approximately Rp2 trillion in one article and Rp2.005 trillion in another, purchased from PT Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara (AKUN); the transaction equals 647.90% of DOOH's consolidated equity as of June 30, 2026, is classified as a highly significant material transaction under POJK 17/2020, and will not change INET's control as AKUN remains controlling shareholder with 29.89%. The four actions comprise: a Rp5 trillion shareholder loan facility from SII (10-year tenor, 7.50% annual interest) with Rp2 trillion drawn initially to fund the INET acquisition; reallocation of Rp120 billion in remaining IPO proceeds as a capital injection into CNI; a rights issue (PMHMETD I) of up to 154.77 billion new shares with Series II Warrants; and governance restructuring including a name change, address change, KBLI 2025 adjustment, board reshuffle, and increase in authorized capital. DOOH targets strengthening five business pillars: AI data centers, high-speed connectivity, terrestrial fiber optic networks, submarine fiber optic networks, and green energy through solar power plants.

topics.topic: PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk (ENRG) plans issuance of 13.28 billion new shares at Rp310
topics.known_state: ENRG will issue 13.28 billion new shares at Rp310 to fund drilling of nine EMP Bentu wells, gas pipeline construction, EOR, and other asset development.

topics.topic: PT Campina Ice Cream Industry Tbk (COCO) signs CSPA to acquire up to 99.99% of PT Sari Murni Abadi
topics.known_state: COCO signed a conditional share purchase agreement to acquire up to 99.99% of PT Sari Murni Abadi (Momogi) to expand distribution, boost production utilization, and create supply chain efficiencies.

topics.topic: PT VKTR Mobilitas Indonesia Tbk (VKTR) obtains OJK effective statement for PMHMETD I of up to Rp3 trillion
topics.known_state: VKTR obtained an OJK effective statement for a PMHMETD I rights issue of up to Rp3 trillion to strengthen working capital and commercial electric vehicle business capacity; shareholders who do not exercise their rights may face dilution.

topics.topic: PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) pays Rp6.16 trillion interim dividend, Rp66 per share
topics.known_state: BMRI began payment of its fiscal year 2026 interim dividend totaling Rp6.16 trillion, or Rp66 per share, on Friday, October 2, 2026. Shareholders on record as of September 17, 2026, 4:00 PM WIB, are entitled, with the cum date in the regular and negotiation markets on September 15. The interim payout is based on financials as of June 30, 2026, in which net profit attributable to owners of the parent entity was Rp30.41 trillion.

topics.topic: PT Aspirasi Hidup Indonesia Tbk (ACES) opens five new NEKA stores in September 2026
topics.known_state: ACES, owner of the Azko brand, opened five new NEKA stores in September 2026 across Central Java, West Java, and Lampung.

topics.topic: PT Golden Energy Mines Tbk (GEMS) approves interim dividend of US$200 million
topics.known_state: GEMS, part of the Sinar Mas group, approved an interim dividend of US$200 million, or US$0.034 (Rp611.93) per share using the BI mid-rate of Rp17,996 per US dollar as of September 30, 2026.

topics.topic: GOTO shares hit Auto Reject Bottom for four consecutive sessions after IDX lowers minimum trading floor price from Rp50 to Rp1
topics.known_state: A new IDX rule lowered the floor price from Rp50 to Rp1 per share, enabling queued sellers to sell. PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) shares hit Auto Reject Bottom for four consecutive sessions from September 28 to October 1, 2026, closing at Rp28 on October 1 after falling 44%, erasing Rp25.06 trillion (43.96%) of market capitalization to Rp31.94 trillion; IDX requested clarification from GOTO. GOTO was removed from the MSCI Global Standard Indexes effective August 31, 2026 (August 2026 review) for technical reasons tied to low trading volume, after being at the Rp50 minimum price since May 2026, and was earlier removed from the FTSE GEIS Mid Cap Index effective June 22, 2026 (June 2026 review) because its development board listing did not meet FTSE criteria; the index exclusions triggered selling pressure from foreign institutional investors, particularly passive funds, which low trading volume had prevented from selling in the regular market until the floor price was lowered. GOTO said the share price does not reflect its continuously strengthening business fundamentals, attributing the dynamics to technical factors.

topics.topic: PT Astra Agro Lestari Tbk (AALI) announces share buyback plan of up to Rp400 billion
topics.known_state: AALI announced a buyback of up to Rp400 billion, excluding brokerage and related fees, using the fluctuating market conditions scheme under POJK No. 13/2023, running from October 2 to December 28, 2026 without GMS approval, funded entirely from internal cash. Repurchased shares will not exceed 20% of issued and paid-up capital, free float will be maintained at no less than 15%, and the buyback may be stopped early if the maximum amount is realized or by company decision, with any halt reported to OJK and announced within two business days. AALI stated the buyback will not materially affect its financial performance, operations, or revenue, and repurchased shares will be held as treasury stock.

topics.topic: PT Era Media Sejahtera (DOOH) acquisition of 29.88% stake in PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima (INET) with funding package
topics.known_state: DOOH, via subsidiary PT Cakrawala Nexus Investama (CNI), plans to acquire 6,685 billion shares (29.88%) of INET from PT Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara (AKUN) at Rp300 per share, totaling Rp2,005 trillion (also reported as Rp2 trillion), equal to 647.90% of DOOH's consolidated equity as of June 30, 2026. The material transaction under POJK No. 17/POJK.04/2020 requires shareholder approval at an EGM scheduled for November 9, 2026. Funding comprises a shareholder loan facility of up to Rp5 trillion from new controller PT Sinergi Internasional Investama (SII) (10-year tenor, 7.50% annual interest, initial Rp2 trillion drawdown for the INET purchase), reallocation of Rp120 billion in remaining IPO funds to CNI, and a rights issue of up to 154.77 billion (also reported as 154.78 billion) new shares at Rp10 nominal with Series II Warrants (up to 95.24% of fully paid-in capital, diluting non-participants up to 95.24%), with proceeds to repay shareholder debt and fund AI Data Centers, high-speed connectivity, fiber optic backbones, and solar power (PLTS). The stake is below the 30% mandatory tender offer threshold, gives no control, and will be recorded as an associate without consolidating INET revenue. The plan follows SII's takeover of 51% of DOOH from PT Prambanan Investasi Sukses on July 30, 2026 at Rp50 per share (about Rp197.34 billion), leaving Prambanan with 15.09% and the public 33.91%, with Tinawati holding 99.90% of SII.

topics.topic: Mandatory tender offer for PT Era Media Sejahtera (DOOH) at Rp148 per share after PT Sinergi Internasional Investama acquires 51%
topics.known_state: PT Sinergi Internasional Investama acquired 3.95 billion shares (51%) of DOOH at Rp50 per share on 30 July 2026, becoming controlling shareholder and triggering a mandatory tender offer under POJK No. 9/2018. The MTO covers up to 2.62 billion shares (about 33.91% held by public and other shareholders) at Rp148 per share, based on the higher of the takeover price and the 90-day average daily high of Rp147.40 (2 May to 30 July 2026), valued at a maximum of Rp388.43 billion funded entirely from internal funds, with PT Yakin Bertumbuh Sekuritas as facilitating securities company. The new controller stated no plans to liquidate DOOH, change dividend policy, delist, or take it private.

topics.topic: PT Astra Agro Lestari (AALI) share buyback of up to Rp400 billion through December 2026
topics.known_state: AALI will buy back up to Rp400 billion of shares from October 2 to December 28, 2026, funded entirely by internal funds, with repurchased shares up to a maximum of 20% of issued and paid-up capital and free float maintained at a minimum of 15%. Proforma as of June 30, 2026: total assets fall from Rp28.9 trillion to Rp28.5 trillion, equity from Rp24.6 trillion to Rp24.2 trillion, and EPS rises from Rp571 to Rp575. Shares will be held as treasury stock, executed gradually or at once through the IDX.

topics.topic: PT Astra Agro Lestari (AALI) interim dividend of Rp233 per share totaling Rp449.03 billion
topics.known_state: AALI will pay an interim cash dividend of Rp233 per share totaling Rp449.03 billion, equal to 40.8% of first-half 2026 net profit. PT Astra International (ASII) receives Rp357.78 billion and DJS Ketenagakerjaan Rp9.78 billion for its 2.18% stake. Cum and ex-dividend dates are 8 and 9 October 2026 for the regular and negotiation markets, and 12 and 13 October 2026 for the cash market. Context: H1 2026 net profit grew 56.5% to Rp1.09 trillion on revenue up 5.6% to Rp15.3 trillion.

topics.topic: PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa (DSSA) H1 2026 results and growth initiatives
topics.known_state: DSSA reported H1 2026 consolidated revenue of US$1.77 billion, up 34.0% year-on-year, with profit attributable to owners up 79.6% to US$174.4 million. The energy pillar generated US$1.53 billion (up 29.8%) and technology/digital infrastructure US$182.2 million (up 89.3%). Initiatives include MoraRepublic's FTTH expansion to 186 cities and regencies, the MyRepublic Air FWA service, and the SMX01 AI-ready data center with Korea Investment Real Asset Management (KIRA) and LG Sinar Mas targeted to operate in Q4 2026. MORA and PT Eka Mas Republik merged into PT Ekamas Mora Republik Tbk (MoraRepublic), an AI joint venture was formed with iFLYTEK, and cash and equivalents stood at US$723.3 million as of June 30, 2026, up 75.2% from end-2025.

topics.topic: PT Astra Graphia (ASGR) cancels interim dividend and converts it into additional final dividend, total payout unchanged at no less than Rp400.05 billion
topics.known_state: ASGR canceled its fiscal year 2026 interim dividend scheme and converted it into an additional final cash dividend, keeping the total payout at no less than Rp400.05 billion, or Rp297 per share, sourced from retained earnings of prior fiscal years. Shareholder approval is required at an EGMS planned for November 2026; the previously announced interim schedule (cum dividend October 7, 2026, payment October 26, 2026) no longer applies, with payment details to be set after the meeting.

topics.topic: Apollo Global (BOGA) H1 2026 net profit down 59.9% to Rp2.45 billion
topics.known_state: BOGA reported H1 2026 net profit of Rp2.45 billion as of June 30, 2026, down 59.9% from Rp6.11 billion, with basic EPS falling to Rp0.64 from Rp1.61. Revenue dropped 25.9% to Rp149.87 billion, gross profit rose to Rp35.48 billion from Rp20.87 billion, other income fell to Rp2.3 billion from Rp22.69 billion, and finance costs rose to Rp12.08 billion from Rp11.82 billion. Total assets stood at Rp737.44 billion (from Rp788.96 billion), liabilities Rp273.39 billion (from Rp327.46 billion), and equity Rp464.05 billion (from Rp461.5 billion).

topics.topic: PT Futura Energi Global (FUTR) CSPA to acquire 51% of PT Dumai Tirta Persada from PT Adhi Karya for Rp141 billion
topics.known_state: FUTR signed a conditional share purchase agreement on September 30, 2026 to acquire 74,353 shares (51%) of PT Dumai Tirta Persada (DTP) from PT Adhi Karya (ADHI) for Rp141 billion after winning an auction. DTP operates a water treatment plant in Dumai, Riau under a KPBU scheme based on a 2019 agreement. The transaction is material, not an affiliate transaction, and the share transfer has not yet become effective pending fulfillment or waiver of conditions precedent; upon completion FUTR becomes majority shareholder with 51%. FUTR disclosed the deal to OJK and IDX on October 1, 2026. ADHI stated the divestment is part of streamlining its portfolio to refocus on engineering and construction and strengthen its financial structure and liquidity.

topics.topic: Saiko Consultancy mandatory tender offer for 45.84% of PT Hassana Boga Sejahtera (NAYZ) at Rp75 per share
topics.known_state: Saiko Consultancy Pte. Ltd., NAYZ's new controlling shareholder, will conduct a mandatory tender offer at Rp75 per share in cash through subsidiary PT Saiko Consultancy Grand (SCG) from October 5 to November 3, 2026, preparing up to Rp87.67 billion (also reported as Rp87.68 billion) to absorb up to 1.17 billion shares (45.84% of fully paid-up capital), with payment due by November 10, 2026. The obligation arose from Saiko's acquisition of 750 million NAYZ shares (29.41%) from PT Asia Intrainvesta at Rp23.5 per share (also reported as Rp23.50) via an IDX crossing on August 19, 2026; full absorption would bring Saiko and SCG's combined stake to 75.26%. Saiko plans to develop NAYZ toward telecommunications and technology, potentially shifting the baby food business to Asia Intrainvesta, and states no plans to delist, go private, liquidate, or change dividend policy.

topics.topic: PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia (JPFA) divests subsidiary Vaksindo's India and Vietnam operations for Rp1.8 trillion
topics.known_state: JPFA is divesting PT Vaksindo Satwa Nusantara, including its India and Vietnam business units, for Rp1.8 trillion to controlling shareholder Japfa Pte Ltd and affiliate Bionovus Pte Ltd. Vaksindo operates in animal health, including vaccine and veterinary pharmaceutical production, livestock support, and trading. Management said the divestment allows focus on core businesses and reinvestment in feed milling, integrated poultry and aquaculture farming, and downstream meat and food processing, with part of net proceeds serving as capital expenditure.

topics.topic: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital (WIFI) board resignations and extraordinary general meeting on 21 October 2026
topics.known_state: WIFI (Surge) received resignation letters from President Commissioner Hashim S. Djojohadikusumo (dated 29 September 2026, received 30 September 2026) and Director Henny Santoso (dated and received 1 October 2026). An EGM is scheduled for Wednesday, 21 October 2026 with an agenda covering changes to the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors composition under POJK 33/2014. The company stated no material impact on operations, legal standing, financial condition, or business continuity. On Friday, 2 October 2026, WIFI shares fell in the first trading session, reported as down 9% to Rp1,465 within the first hour and as down 11.15%, or 180 points, to Rp1,435 per share.

topics.topic: PT Berlina (BRNA) rights issue of up to 543,950,000 new shares at Rp685 with free Series I warrants
topics.known_state: BRNA plans a rights issue (PMHMETD III) of up to 543,950,000 (also reported as 543.95 million) new shares with Rp50 nominal, equal to 55.56% of placed and paid-up capital. Shareholders recorded on October 12, 2026 receive rights on a 9:5 basis, exercisable at Rp685 per share, for potential proceeds of up to Rp372,605,750,000 (about Rp372.61 billion). Up to 181,316,667 (about 181.32 million) free Series I warrants will be issued (1 warrant per 3 new shares subscribed) with an Rp800 exercise price. About 70.95% of proceeds (Rp264.38 billion) will settle debt to majority shareholder PT Dwi Satrya Utama (DSU), whose stake is projected to rise from 54.57% to 60.97%, with the exercise scheduled for 14-21 October 2026.

topics.topic: GEMS coal production and sales target of up to 58 million tons in 2026
topics.known_state: GEMS targets coal production and sales of up to 58 million tons in 2026, above its 2025 realization of 54.95 million tons. About 65% of 2025 sales came from exports (China 52%, India 6%, other countries 7%) and 35% from the domestic market.

topics.topic: BBRM completes purchase of AHTS vessel MP Maverick for USD12.10 million funded by Rp120 billion Bank IBK loan
topics.known_state: BBRM completed the purchase of the 80T BP Anchor Handling Tug Supply vessel MP Maverick (6,000 BHP) from Great Union China Limited for USD12.10 million, funded by a Rp120 billion investment loan from Bank IBK, strengthening its offshore support vessel segment, which contributed USD6.21 million, or about 93.41%, of 1H26 revenue.

topics.topic: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BBRI) 8M2026 bank-only net profit of Rp34.8 trillion and raised 2026 loan growth guidance to 8%-10%
topics.known_state: BBRI posted bank-only net profit of Rp34.8 trillion for the first eight months of 2026, up 6.6% year on year, supported by net interest income growth of 3.4% and pre-provision operating profit growth of 6.7%, amid persistent NIM pressure. Loans reached Rp1,447 trillion in August 2026, up 13.7% yoy, prompting management to raise 2026 loan growth guidance to 8%-10% from 7%-9%, while cost of credit fell to 3.29% from 3.34%. Deposits grew 12.6% yoy to Rp1,656 trillion, improving the LDR to 87.4% from 89.7% in July, though CASA slipped to 64.8% from 66.2% amid a shift toward costlier funding.

topics.topic: PT Satu Visi Putra (VISI) headquarters relocation, holding company conversion, and private placement of 307.5 million shares to fund majority acquisition of PT Hasna Medika Bakti Cirebon
topics.known_state: VISI shareholders, including controlling shareholders Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, approved on 30 September 2026 relocating headquarters from Surabaya to Wisma KEIAI in Central Jakarta, converting the company to a holding company, and a private placement of 307.5 million new shares estimated to raise more than Rp280 billion. Proceeds will fund the majority acquisition of PT Hasna Medika Bakti Cirebon (HMBC), a heart hospital operator, through which Raffi and Nagita will control 72.91% of HMBC shares, with creditor conversions bringing in Pieter Tanuri (11.62%), Roy Himawan, and Darwin Cyril Noerhadi as shareholders.

topics.topic: Danantara plan to merge BUMN Karya construction companies starting with PT PP and PT Adhi Karya
topics.known_state: BPI Danantara COO Dony Oskaria said the merger of state-owned construction companies could be pursued as early as this year, starting with PT PP (PTPP) and PT Adhi Karya (ADHI), followed by Brantas and Indra Karya, with ADHI and PTPP targeting completion by end of 2026. Companies requiring restructuring, primarily WIKA and Waskita Karya, will be handled afterward, while Hutama Karya is considered healthy. The broader consolidation plan covers BUMN Karya companies including Hutama Karya, Waskita Karya, WIKA, PTPP, Brantas Abipraya, ADHI, and Nindya Karya. ADHI is simplifying its business structure to refocus on engineering and construction and has signed debt restructuring agreements with several state-owned banks covering around Rp3 trillion in debt as of July 2026.

topics.topic: GOTO extraordinary general meeting on 14 October 2026 to cancel 32,186,417,802 series A treasury shares
topics.known_state: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) will seek shareholder approval at an EGM on 14 October 2026 to cancel 32,186,417,802 series A treasury shares bought back between 12 June 2024 and 11 June 2025. The company had previously secured approval for a share buyback of up to Rp3.5 trillion running from 19 June 2026 to 18 June 2027.

topics.topic: Bank Mandiri (BMRI) fiscal year 2026 interim dividend of Rp66 per share totaling around Rp6.16 trillion
topics.known_state: BMRI paid an interim dividend for fiscal year 2026 of Rp66 per share, totaling around Rp6.16 trillion, on 2 October 2026, coinciding with its 28th anniversary. Total dividends across calendar 2026 reached about Rp50.63 trillion, comprising Rp44.47 trillion from fiscal year 2025 and Rp6.16 trillion in interim dividends. Through August 2026, bank-only loans grew 17.6% yoy to Rp1,592 trillion, third-party funds rose 17.6% yoy to Rp1,687 trillion, total assets reached Rp2,358 trillion (up 20.7% yoy), and net profit rose 22.3% yoy to Rp37.5 trillion, with a gross NPL ratio of 1.00% and NPL coverage of 240.6%.

topics.topic: PT Teladan Prima Agro (TLDN) interim dividend of Rp20 per share totaling Rp258.93 billion
topics.known_state: TLDN declared an interim dividend for fiscal year 2026 of Rp20 per share, totaling Rp258.93 billion, approved by the Board of Commissioners on October 1, 2026, payable to shareholders recorded on October 14, 2026 with payment scheduled for October 22, 2026. Cum and ex-dividend dates for the regular and negotiation markets were reported differently: cum dividend on October 12, 2026 in one report, and cum dividend on October 14, 2026 with ex dividend on October 15, 2026 in another. Context: H1 2026 revenue of Rp2.71 trillion (up 6.5% yoy), EBITDA of Rp904.30 billion (up 3.8%), and net profit of Rp543.65 billion, supported by higher sales volumes and average CPO, PK, and CPKO prices.

topics.topic: PT Adhi Karya (ADHI) CSPA with PT Sarana Multi Infrastruktur to divest 47.18% stake in PT Jasamarga Jogja Solo
topics.known_state: ADHI signed a Conditional Share Purchase Agreement on 30 September 2026 with PT Sarana Multi Infrastruktur (Persero) (SMI) to divest its 47.18% stake in PT Jasamarga Jogja Solo (JMJ). The divestment aims to refocus ADHI on its core engineering and construction business while strengthening its financial structure and liquidity.
